name: Maldives Private Overwater Villa & Coral Atoll Safari
title: Maldives Private Overwater Villa & Coral Atoll Safari
description: Stay in an ultra-luxurious overwater villa perched above a turquoise lagoon, snorkel pristine house reefs, and cruise at sunset with wild dolphins.
shortDescription: Luxury overwater bungalow, turquoise lagoons, and dolphin sunset cruise.
fullDescription: Indulge in the ultimate tropical sanctuary in the Maldives. Wake up to direct lagoon access from your private sun deck, indulge in a floating Champagne breakfast, snorkel alongside hawksbill turtles and eagle rays on protected house reefs, and cap your days with a private Dhoni sunset cruise.
highlights: Overwater pool villa with direct ocean staircase
Private speedboat or seaplane scenic arrival transfer
Coral reef snorkeling safari with marine biologist
Sunset dolphin cruise with French Champagne and canapés
Floating breakfast in your private infinity pool
included: 5 Nights luxury 5-star overwater pool villa
All-inclusive gourmet dining across 4 specialty restaurants
Roundtrip seaplane / luxury speedboat airport transfers
Complimentary non-motorized water sports & snorkel gear
One 60-minute couple's overwater spa massage

itinerary.title: Seaplane Arrival & Overwater Villa Check-in
itinerary.description: Scenic aerial flight over turquoise atolls. Welcome glass of bubbly and personal butler check-in to your private overwater suite.

itinerary.title: House Reef Snorkel & Floating Breakfast
itinerary.description: Floating breakfast in your pool. Guided marine biologist reef safari spotting clownfish, manta rays, and harmless blacktip reef sharks.

itinerary.title: Sandbank Picnic & Lagoon Water Sports
itinerary.description: Private boat excursion to an uninhabited sandbank with white canopy shade, chilled seafood lunch, and stand-up paddleboarding.

itinerary.title: Overwater Spa & Sunset Dolphin Cruise
itinerary.description: Relax with a signature massage over glass-bottom floors. In the late afternoon, embark on a traditional dhoni cruise tracking spinner dolphins.

itinerary.title: Underwater Dining & Starry Beachfront Cinema
itinerary.description: Optional gourmet underwater lunch surrounded by coral. Evening beach cinema under the tropical stars.

itinerary.title: Island Departure
itinerary.description: Breakfast with sweeping panoramic ocean views, leisure time in lagoon, and seaplane transfer to Velana International Airport.

guestReviews.author: Charlotte Montgomery
guestReviews.text: The Maldives overwater villa was pure paradise. Seeing dolphins at sunset was unforgettable.

guestReviews.author: David Sterling
guestReviews.text: Flawless service and unmatched coral reef clarity. Worth every single penny.

name: Santorini Caldera Private Catamaran & Oia Cliffside Retreat
title: Santorini Caldera Private Catamaran & Oia Cliffside Retreat
description: Admire white-washed cubist architecture and blue domes in Oia, cruise the submerged volcanic caldera on a luxury catamaran, and relax on Red Beach.
shortDescription: Iconic blue domes, private caldera sailing, and cliffside infinity pools.
fullDescription: Experience the romance of Greece's most dramatic island. Perched high on the volcanic rim of Oia, stay in a whitewashed cave suite with infinity plunge pool overlooking the Aegean. Sail past volcanic hot springs and towering caldera cliffs on a private catamaran cruise with fresh Greek barbecue and Assyrtiko wine.
highlights: Cave suite in Oia with private caldera-facing infinity plunge pool
Private catamaran sunset cruise with volcano hot springs swim
Wine tasting at Santo Wines overlooking the Aegean
Exploration of Red Beach, White Beach, and Akrotiri archaeological site
Sunset dining reservations at high-demand Oia cliffside tavernas
included: 4 Nights in 5-star Oia luxury cave suite
Full-day private catamaran sailing with seafood BBQ and wine
Private vehicle and driver for island touring
Daily gourmet Greek breakfast delivered to your private terrace

itinerary.title: Arrival in Santorini & Oia Check-in
itinerary.description: Private luxury transfer from Thira Airport to your cliffside suite in Oia. Enjoy an evening stroll among cobblestones and world-famous sunset vistas.

itinerary.title: Private Caldera Catamaran Cruise
itinerary.description: Board a sleek catamaran at Ammoudi Bay. Sail to the Nea Kameni volcanic hot springs, snorkel by Indian Rock, and anchor at White Beach for fresh grilled seafood.

itinerary.title: Volcanic Vineyards & Akrotiri Excavation
itinerary.description: Tour prehistoric Akrotiri, known as the Minoan Pompeii. Sample indigenous crisp Assyrtiko wines at cliffside estates.

itinerary.title: Perissa Black Sand Beach & Fira Walking Tour
itinerary.description: Relax at a luxury beach club on the volcanic black sands of Perissa, followed by an evening in vibrant Fira.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: Terrace breakfast admiring the caldera panorama before your transfer to the airport or ferry port.

guestReviews.author: Lucas Vance
guestReviews.text: The catamaran sailing and sunset in Oia took our breath away. Exemplary hospitality.

name: Bora Bora Polynesian Pearl Lagoon & Overwater Haven
title: Bora Bora Polynesian Pearl Lagoon & Overwater Haven
description: Awaken facing emerald Mount Otemanu, snorkel with stingrays and reef sharks in translucent lagoons, and canoe-deliver breakfast.
shortDescription: Mount Otemanu views, stingray lagoon safari, and Tahitian luxury.
fullDescription: Known as the Jewel of the South Pacific, Bora Bora offers an unmatched blend of volcanic majesty and serene neon-blue waters. Stay at a premier resort on a private motu, swim in coral gardens with graceful manta rays, and immerse yourself in rich Tahitian culture.
highlights: Premium overwater villa with direct views of Mount Otemanu
Traditional outrigger canoe breakfast delivered to your bungalow deck
Lagoon safari swimming with gentle stingrays and blacktip sharks
Motu private picnic with traditional Polynesian ground-oven cuisine
Deep sea pearl farm tour and pearl harvesting
included: 5 Nights 5-star luxury overwater villa
Inter-island boat transfers from Bora Bora Airport
Daily breakfast and candlelit beach dinners
Full-day guided private lagoon safari

itinerary.title: Tahiti to Bora Bora Motu Transfer
itinerary.description: Scenic domestic flight past coral rings. Private boat transfer across glowing blue waters to your motu resort.

itinerary.title: Shark & Ray Lagoon Safari
itinerary.description: Board a traditional Polynesian pirogue boat to shallow sandbanks where friendly stingrays and blacktip reef sharks swim peacefully.

itinerary.title: Outrigger Canoe Breakfast & Coral Gardens
itinerary.description: Canoe brings a fresh tropical breakfast to your sundeck. Afternoon snorkeling through the vibrant Anau coral gardens.

itinerary.title: Private Motu Feast & Polynesian Culture
itinerary.description: Savor grilled mahi-mahi and poisson cru on a secluded motu, with demonstrations of coconut husking and pareo tying.

itinerary.title: Day of Pure Relaxation & Sunset Cruise
itinerary.description: Lounge by the infinity pool or take glass-bottom kayaks across the reef. Sunset champagne cruise around the island.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: Farewell Polynesian floral lei presentation and boat transfer back to Bora Bora Airport.

guestReviews.author: Sophia Turner
guestReviews.text: Unsurpassed luxury. Mount Otemanu right outside our bedroom window was pure heaven.

name: Amalfi Coast Positano & Capri Private Yacht Charter
title: Amalfi Coast Positano & Capri Private Yacht Charter
description: Cruise past Positano's pastel cliff dwellings, swim into the glowing Blue Grotto of Capri, and dine on fresh Mediterranean fare in Ravello.
shortDescription: Positano cliffside vistas, Capri Blue Grotto, and luxury Riva yacht.
fullDescription: Celebrate the Dolce Vita lifestyle along Italy's most glamorous coast. From the cliff-clinging pastel villas of Positano to the historic aristocratic villas of Ravello, explore by private speed yacht. Sail around Capri's towering Faraglioni rock formations, anchor for cliff jumping in emerald coves, and taste handmade limoncello.
highlights: Full-day private Riva yacht charter to Capri and Faraglioni Rocks
Private tender access inside the luminous Blue Grotto
Cliffside luxury hotel stay in Positano overlooking Spiaggia Grande
Exclusive lemon grove tour and handcrafted limoncello tasting in Amalfi
Terrace dining in Ravello at Villa Cimbrone
included: 4 Nights in 5-star cliffside boutique hotel in Positano
Private motor yacht charter with skipper, fuel, and champagne bar
Private Mercedes-Benz chauffeur for all coastal road transfers
Daily artisan Italian breakfast
excluded: Capri Blue Grotto rowboat entry fee

itinerary.title: Naples to Positano Coastal Drive
itinerary.description: Private luxury transfer along the iconic panoramic Amalfi cliff roads. Check into your Positano room with private sea balcony.

itinerary.title: Private Yacht Voyage to Capri
itinerary.description: Cruise from Positano dock across the Bay of Salerno. Anchor by the Faraglioni rocks, visit Capri town for designer shopping, and swim in turquoise coves.

itinerary.title: Amalfi Town & Ravello Gardens
itinerary.description: Explore the 9th-century Amalfi cathedral, followed by a visit to Ravello’s Villa Rufolo and Villa Cimbrone perched high above the sea.

itinerary.title: Beach Club Leisure & Wine Tasting
itinerary.description: Spend a relaxing morning at a secluded cove beach club reached only by boat. Evening sunset seafood dinner in Praiano.

itinerary.title: Arrivederci Positano
itinerary.description: Leisurely morning cappuccino overlooking the cliffs before transfer back to Naples.

guestReviews.author: Marcus Bennett
guestReviews.text: Sailing through the Faraglioni rock arch on a private yacht was the highlight of our European vacation.

name: Maui & Lanai Private Catamaran & Kaanapali Coastal Voyage
title: Maui & Lanai Private Catamaran & Kaanapali Coastal Voyage
description: Sail from West Maui across the Auau Channel to secluded sea cliffs in Lanai, snorkel Molokini Crater, and relax on golden Kaanapali Beach.
shortDescription: Molokini crater coral, Lanai sea cliffs, and Hawaiian sunset sail.
fullDescription: Experience the magic of the Valley Isle. Stay in luxury along the golden sands of Kaanapali, sail across the channel on a state-of-the-art catamaran to secluded coves on Lanai, and dive into the crystal crescent of Molokini Crater surrounded by hundreds of Hawaiian green sea turtles.
highlights: Private catamaran expedition across the Auau Channel to Lanai
Snorkeling inside the protected volcanic crater of Molokini
Encountering Hawaiian green sea turtles (honu) at Turtle Town
Beachfront resort stay in Kaanapali or Wailea
Traditional oceanfront luau celebration with Polynesian fire dancers
included: 4 Nights in 5-star beachfront resort in Maui
2 Luxury catamaran sailing tours with meals and open bar
Rental SUV with unlimited mileage for island exploration
VIP tickets to premier beachfront Polynesian Luau

itinerary.title: Aloha Maui Arrival
itinerary.description: Arrive at Kahului Airport. Pick up your SUV and drive the scenic coastal route to your luxury resort in Kaanapali. Sunset cocktails on the beach.

itinerary.title: Molokini Crater & Turtle Town Catamaran
itinerary.description: Early morning catamaran sail to Molokini’s marine sanctuary. Visibility often exceeds 150 feet. Swim with tropical reef fish and sea turtles.

itinerary.title: Lanai Coastal Sea Cliffs & Spinner Dolphins
itinerary.description: Sail across to the pristine island of Lanai. Marvel at rugged red cliffs and watch acrobatic spinner dolphins leaping in the wake.

itinerary.title: Road to Hana Scenic Drive or Beach Relaxation
itinerary.description: Optional scenic drive past waterfalls and rainforests to Hana, or leisure day lounging on Makena Beach followed by an oceanfront Luau feast.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: Morning beach walk and Hawaiian coffee before airport return.

guestReviews.author: Emily Dawson
guestReviews.text: Molokini snorkeling was surreal, and the Lanai catamaran sail was magnificent.

name: Seychelles La Digue Granite Boulders & Praslin Anse Lazio
title: Seychelles La Digue Granite Boulders & Praslin Anse Lazio
description: Cycle past ancient granite boulders at Anse Source d'Argent, explore the primeval Coco de Mer palm forest in Vallée de Mai, and relax on Anse Lazio.
shortDescription: Iconic granite beaches, Vallée de Mai coco de mer, and Creole island luxury.
fullDescription: Step into an earthly Eden in the Seychelles archipelago. Marvel at the sculptured pink granite monoliths standing against turquoise waters at Anse Source d'Argent on bicycle-friendly La Digue, wander through the UNESCO-listed Vallée de Mai on Praslin, and relax in world-class eco-resorts.
bestTime: April to May, October to November
highlights: Anse Source d'Argent iconic pink granite boulders exploration
UNESCO World Heritage Vallée de Mai ancient Coco de Mer palm reserve
Catamaran sailing to Curieuse Island and Aldabra giant tortoise encounters
Beachfront pool villa stay on Cote d'Or Beach in Praslin
Gourmet Creole beach seafood dining with feet in the sand
included: 6 Nights 5-star beachfront luxury resort accommodation
Inter-island ferry transfers (Mahé - Praslin - La Digue)
Daily tropical breakfast and 3 curated gourmet Creole dinners
Private guided island excursions and national park permits

itinerary.title: Mahé to Praslin Scenic Ferry or Flight
itinerary.description: Arrive at Mahé and transfer across turquoise waters to Praslin. Check into your beachfront pool villa.

itinerary.title: Vallée de Mai & Anse Lazio Beach
itinerary.description: Walk through the prehistoric palm forest home to the legendary Coco de Mer nut. Spend the afternoon swimming at breathtaking Anse Lazio.

itinerary.title: La Digue Bicycle Safari & Anse Source d'Argent
itinerary.description: Take a short ferry to La Digue. Rent retro bicycles to explore vanilla plantations and the photogenic granite boulders of Anse Source d'Argent.

itinerary.title: Curieuse Island Giant Tortoises & St. Pierre Snorkel
itinerary.description: Catamaran excursion to Curieuse Island to walk among free-roaming giant Aldabra tortoises. Snorkel vibrant coral around St. Pierre islet.

itinerary.title: Anse Georgette Secluded Cove & Sunset Cocktails
itinerary.description: Private access to the secluded powdery crescent of Anse Georgette. Relax with coconut water and chilled champagne.

itinerary.title: Praslin Coastal Cruise & Creole Feast
itinerary.description: Half-day coastal cruise with line fishing, followed by a beachfront Creole barbecue dinner featuring grilled red snapper.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: Transfer back to Mahé International Airport for your flight home.

guestReviews.author: Nathaniel Price
guestReviews.text: The granite boulders on La Digue look like something sculpted by gods. Truly sublime.

name: St. Barts & Anguilla Private Superyacht Archipelago Cruise
title: St. Barts & Anguilla Private Superyacht Archipelago Cruise
description: Cruise the French West Indies in style, anchor at Colombier Beach in St. Barts, and lounge on the powdery sands of Shoal Bay East in Anguilla.
shortDescription: Glamorous St. Barts chic, private yacht anchorage, and Anguilla sands.
fullDescription: Live the epitome of Caribbean chic and understated glamour. Board a luxury chartered yacht to sail between the fashionable French enclave of St. Barts and the pristine turquoise waters of Anguilla. Anchor in tranquil bays, dine at world-renowned beach clubs like Nikki Beach, and snorkel with sea turtles.
highlights: Private luxury yacht charter sailing between St. Barts and Anguilla
Secluded anchorage at Colombier Beach (former Rockefeller estate)
VIP day bed reservations at Nikki Beach St. Barth in Saint-Jean Bay
Swimming in neon-cyan waters of Shoal Bay East Anguilla
Five-star beachfront villa accommodation with private infinity pool
included: 4 Nights luxury villa / luxury yacht accommodation
Dedicated skipper, yacht crew, and private chef on board
All port clearance fees, marina berthing, and water toys (Seabob)
VIP airport concierge on St. Maarten / St. Barts

itinerary.title: Gustavia Harbor Welcome & Saint-Jean Beach
itinerary.description: Arrive in St. Barts. Board your yacht in Gustavia harbor. Enjoy afternoon cocktails overlooking superyachts and sunset dinner.

itinerary.title: Colombier Beach Secluded Anchorage
itinerary.description: Sail to pristine Colombier Bay accessible only by boat or foot. Snorkel with spotted eagle rays and green turtles.

itinerary.title: Sail to Anguilla & Shoal Bay East
itinerary.description: Set sail across the channel to Anguilla. Anchor at Shoal Bay East, renowned for blindingly white sands and crystal azure shallows.

itinerary.title: Little Bay Cliffs & Sandy Ground Beach Party
itinerary.description: Cliff jump into Little Bay cove. Enjoy chilled Caribbean lobster and live reggae music at Sandy Ground.

itinerary.title: Return Sail & Departure
itinerary.description: Morning breakfast sail back to St. Barts or St. Maarten for your departure.

guestReviews.author: Harrison Forde
guestReviews.text: The yacht charter and Seabob underwater scootering in Colombier Bay was out of this world.

name: Fiji Yasawa Islands & Coral Coast Turquoise Escape
title: Fiji Yasawa Islands & Coral Coast Turquoise Escape
description: Immerse in Fijian Bula hospitality, explore the sacred Sawa-i-Lau limestone sea caves, and snorkel vibrant blue coral lagoons.
shortDescription: Sawa-i-Lau sea caves, authentic Bula warmth, and private beach bure.
fullDescription: Escape to the sun-drenched Yasawa archipelago in western Fiji. Stay in traditional luxury beachfront bures, swim through cathedral-like sea caves submerged in sapphire water, partake in authentic Kava welcoming ceremonies, and snorkel teeming marine reserves.
highlights: Traditional luxury beachfront bure with private outdoor stone shower
Mystical Sawa-i-Lau limestone sea cave swimming expedition
Snorkeling in the famous Blue Lagoon coral reefs
Authentic Fijian village visit and Sevusevu Kava ceremony
Lovo subterranean earth-oven feast accompanied by Fijian choral singing
included: 5 Nights 5-star beachfront resort in the Yasawa Islands
Seaplane transfer from Nadi International Airport
Full board gourmet dining including traditional Lovo feasts
Guided cave excursions, kayak gear, and snorkel equipment

itinerary.title: Nadi to Yasawa Seaplane Flight
itinerary.description: Breathtaking seaplane flight over coral reefs. Warm Fijian acoustic guitar and floral song welcome at your beach bure.

itinerary.title: Blue Lagoon Snorkeling & Reef Safari
itinerary.description: Boat excursion into the calm waters of the Blue Lagoon. Spot turquoise damselfish, clownfish, and sea anemones.

itinerary.title: Sacred Sawa-i-Lau Caves Expedition
itinerary.description: Cruise to northern Yasawa to enter the ancient limestone caves carved by sea waves. Swim beneath soaring natural domes.

itinerary.title: Fijian Village Culture & Lovo Banquet
itinerary.description: Participate in an authentic kava drinking ceremony with local village elders. Enjoy a traditional dinner cooked underground with hot river stones.

itinerary.title: Sunset Kayaking & Beach Leisure
itinerary.description: Paddle along calm lagoon coves or unwind in a hammock under swaying palm trees. Romantic beach campfire under starry skies.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: Farewell Isa Lei song performance by resort staff before seaplane return to Nadi.

guestReviews.author: Kirsten Bradley
guestReviews.text: The warmth of the Fijian people and the beauty of the Yasawa caves is something I will treasure forever.

name: Riviera Maya Private Cenotes & Tulum Beachfront Haven
title: Riviera Maya Private Cenotes & Tulum Beachfront Haven
description: Lounge on bohemian white-sand Tulum beaches, snorkel secret crystalline limestone cenotes, and explore Mayan cliffside ruins.
shortDescription: Tulum bohemian luxury, Mayan cliff temples, and mystical cenotes.
fullDescription: Blend bohemian chic aesthetics with ancient Mesoamerican majesty along Mexico’s Caribbean coastline. Stay in an eco-luxury beachfront villa in Tulum, explore the clifftop Mayan fortress overlooking the sea, swim through sunlit limestone sinkholes (cenotes), and enjoy farm-to-table Mexican culinary artistry.
highlights: Beachfront eco-luxury cabana stay on Tulum Beach Road
Private early-access visit to Tulum Mayan cliffside ruins before crowds
Exclusive swimming in private freshwater cenotes with stalactites
Catamaran sailing and snorkeling on the Mesoamerican Barrier Reef
Dinner tasting menu with artisanal mezcal pairings at Hartwood or Gitano
included: 4 Nights in luxury beachfront boutique hotel in Tulum
Private Suburban transfers with chauffeur and cold drinks
All cenote access fees and private archeological guide
Daily artisan breakfast and one 5-course chef's dinner

itinerary.title: Cancun/Tulum Arrival & Beachfront Welcome
itinerary.description: Private luxury transfer to Tulum’s stylish hotel zone. Walk straight out onto powdery white sand. Welcome margarita and fresh ceviche.

itinerary.title: Tulum Mayan Ruins & Cenote Dos Ojos
itinerary.description: Beat the heat with a private morning exploration of the Mayan fortress above the waves. Cool off in the crystal subterranean waters of Cenote Dos Ojos.

itinerary.title: Sian Ka'an Biosphere Canal Floating
itinerary.description: Visit the UNESCO Sian Ka'an Biosphere reserve. Drift peacefully through ancient Mayan freshwater canals bordered by mangroves.

itinerary.title: Catamaran Sailing & Bohemian Jungle Night
itinerary.description: Private catamaran cruise along the coast with reef snorkeling. In the evening, explore Tulum’s vibrant jungle restaurants and candlelit bars.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: Morning yoga on the beach and fresh tropical smoothie bowl before airport transfer.

guestReviews.author: Samantha Wright
guestReviews.text: The cenote swimming was spiritual and Tulum’s beach vibe is unmatched.

name: Mykonos & Delos Private Motor Yacht & Super Paradise Retreat
title: Mykonos & Delos Private Motor Yacht & Super Paradise Retreat
description: Enjoy world-class beach clubs, private motor yacht sailing to the sacred ruins of Delos, and wind-blown Cycladic romance.
shortDescription: Mykonos beach clubs, ancient Delos sanctuary, and private motor yacht.
fullDescription: Combine glamorous Aegean beach life with ancient mythological history. Stay in a luxury hillside villa overlooking Psarou Beach, sail on a private motor yacht to the uninhabited sanctuary island of Delos—birthplace of Apollo—and party or relax at celebrated beach clubs like Scorpios and Nammos.
highlights: Private motor yacht charter to Delos UNESCO sacred ruins and Rhenia coves
VIP daybed reservation at Scorpios beach club for sunset ritual
Hillside Cycladic villa with infinity pool and Aegean sea views
Walking tour of Mykonos Old Town windmills and Little Venice
Gourmet seafood dining at sea-facing taverna in Ornos
included: 4 Nights in 5-star Mykonos luxury boutique resort
Full-day private motor yacht charter with skipper, fuel, and lunch
Private driver and luxury van at disposal for beach transfers
Daily champagne breakfast

itinerary.title: Arrival in Mykonos & Little Venice Sunset
itinerary.description: Private airport transfer to your resort. Wander through whitewashed alleys to the iconic windmills and toast the sunset in Little Venice.

itinerary.title: Private Yacht to Ancient Delos & Rhenia Island
itinerary.description: Sail to the sacred birthplace of Apollo and Artemis. Explore ancient mosaics and marble temples. Anchor at uninhabited Rhenia for turquoise swimming.

itinerary.title: South Coast Beaches & Psarou Beach Club
itinerary.description: Spend a glamorous beach day on Psarou Beach, with crystal waters, chilled rosé, and luxury yacht watching.

itinerary.title: Scorpios Sunset Ritual & Fine Dining
itinerary.description: Afternoon relaxation followed by the world-famous Scorpios sunset music ritual with ambient live rhythms and Mediterranean dining.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: Terrace breakfast overlooking the Aegean before transfer to the airport or ferry.

guestReviews.author: Alexander Cruz
guestReviews.text: The yacht charter to Rhenia was idyllic. Pure Aegean luxury.

name: Swiss Alps Matterhorn Glacier Trek & Zermatt Heli-Tour
title: Swiss Alps Matterhorn Glacier Trek & Zermatt Heli-Tour
description: Take a scenic helicopter flight right next to the iconic Matterhorn, traverse Gorner Glacier with crampons, and stay in Alpine luxury.
shortDescription: Matterhorn helicopter flight, glacier ice trekking, and Zermatt luxury chalets.
fullDescription: Ascend into the towering wonderland of the Swiss high Alps. Based in the car-free alpine village of Zermatt, embark on an exhilarating helicopter flight around the pyramid face of the Matterhorn, gear up with an IFMGA mountain guide for a Gorner Glacier crampon trek, and relax in world-class thermal spas.
highlights: Scenic Matterhorn Air Zermatt helicopter flight skimming sheer rock faces
Guided Gorner Glacier expedition with crampons, harness, and ice axes
Gornergrat cogwheel train ride with panoramic views of 29 peaks over 4,000m
5-Star Alpine wellness resort stay with Matterhorn-facing heated outdoor pool
Traditional Valais cheese fondue and Swiss wine tasting at mountain chalet
included: 4 Nights luxury Alpine wellness resort in Zermatt
Air Zermatt Matterhorn helicopter flight experience
Certified IFMGA mountain guide and all glacier technical gear
Gornergrat railway and Matterhorn Glacier Paradise cable car passes
Daily Swiss breakfast buffet and 2 gourmet dinners

itinerary.title: Arrive in Zermatt & Alpine Welcome
itinerary.description: Scenic train into car-free Zermatt. Electric taxi transfer to your luxury chalet. Welcome glass of Swiss wine overlooking the Matterhorn.

itinerary.title: Gornergrat Ascent & Riffelsee Reflection
itinerary.description: Take Europe's highest open-air cogwheel train to Gornergrat (3,089m). Hike down past Riffelsee to photograph the iconic Matterhorn reflection.

itinerary.title: Gorner Glacier Crampon Expedition
itinerary.description: Equip crampons and rope up with your guide to explore deep blue crevasses, ice caves, and glacial moulins across Gorner Glacier.

itinerary.title: Matterhorn Helicopter Flight & Thermal Spa
itinerary.description: Board an Air Zermatt helicopter for a jaw-dropping flight circling the Matterhorn summit. Afternoon spent unwinding in the mountain spa.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: Breakfast with alpine views, stroll through historic wooden sun-baked barns in Hinterdorf, and train departure.

guestReviews.author: Dominic Taylor
guestReviews.text: Walking on the glacier with the Matterhorn towering above us was the greatest adventure of my life.

name: Queenstown Heli-Bungee, Jet Boating & Milford Sound Flight
title: Queenstown Heli-Bungee, Jet Boating & Milford Sound Flight
description: Thrill to the adventure capital of the world: Shotover River jet boating, Nevis highwire bungee, and scenic flight into majestic Milford Sound.
shortDescription: Shotover jet boating, Nevis bungee, and Milford Sound fiord flight.
fullDescription: Immerse yourself in non-stop adrenaline against the cinematic backdrop of New Zealand’s Southern Alps. Skim past sheer canyon walls on the legendary Shotover Jet, take a scenic fixed-wing flight landing in Milford Sound for a fiord cruise under Stirling Falls, and test your courage on the Nevis highwire.
highlights: Scenic flight across Southern Alps glaciers into Milford Sound
Milford Sound boutique boat cruise right beneath thunderous waterfalls
High-speed 360-degree spins on the world-famous Shotover Jet
Nevis Bungee Jump (134m) or Nevis Catapult adventure
Skyline Gondola & Luge rides overlooking Lake Wakatipu and The Remarkables
included: 4 Nights in 5-star Lake Wakatipu waterfront boutique hotel
Milford Sound Fly-Cruise-Fly experience with glacier flight
Shotover Jet canyon boat pass and safety gear
Nevis Highwire activity pass (Bungee or Swing)
Daily gourmet Kiwi breakfast and one vineyard lunch

itinerary.title: Arrive in Queenstown & Lake Wakatipu Sunset
itinerary.description: Arrive at Queenstown Airport. Transfer to your lakeside hotel. Skyline gondola ascent for panoramic sunset views over The Remarkables.

itinerary.title: Shotover Jet Canyons & Gibbston Valley Wine
itinerary.description: Experience adrenaline-fueled 360-degree spins through narrow rock canyons. Decompress in the afternoon tasting world-renowned Central Otago Pinot Noir.

itinerary.title: Milford Sound Scenic Glacier Flight & Cruise
itinerary.description: Fly over snowcapped alpine peaks into Fiordland National Park. Cruise deep into Milford Sound alongside seals and beneath towering Mitre Peak.

itinerary.title: Nevis Bungee or Canyon Swing
itinerary.description: Journey into the rugged Nevis gorge. Leap 134 meters from the suspended highwire pod over the river valley. Evening lakeside celebration.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: Leisurely breakfast at Queenstown bay before airport transfer.

guestReviews.author: Ethan Walker
guestReviews.text: Milford Sound flight was the most majestic scenery on Earth, and the Shotover Jet was heart-pumping fun!

name: Costa Rica Arenal Volcano Canopy, Hanging Bridges & Whitewater
title: Costa Rica Arenal Volcano Canopy, Hanging Bridges & Whitewater
description: Zipline through cloudforest canopies, conquer Class IV rapids on the Pacuare River, and soak in volcanic thermal springs with views of Arenal.
shortDescription: Arenal volcano ziplines, Pacuare Class IV rafting, and geothermal hot springs.
fullDescription: Immerse in Costa Rica's pure adventure playground (Pura Vida). Zipline above the tropical forest canopy facing the imposing cone of Arenal Volcano, trek across dizzying hanging bridges spotting toucans and howler monkeys, paddle thrilling Class III-IV rapids down the wild Pacuare River gorge, and relax in thermal springs.
highlights: Extreme zipline canopy tour flying hundreds of feet above rainforest valleys
Full-day Class III-IV whitewater rafting down the world-famous Pacuare River
Mistico Arenal Hanging Bridges guided jungle wildlife trek
Tabacón Grand Thermal Resort private access with natural volcanic hot river
Stay in eco-luxury rainforest lodge with private plunge pool
included: 5 Nights in luxury eco-resorts (Nayara Springs / Pacuare Lodge)
All adventure gear, safety helmets, harnesses, and river guides
Private Mercedes Sprinter transfers with cold bottled water
All meals during the Pacuare rafting expedition and daily organic breakfast

itinerary.title: San José to Arenal Luxury Lodge
itinerary.description: Arrive in San José. Private scenic drive through rolling hills to Arenal. Check into your rainforest villa with views of the volcano.

itinerary.title: Arenal Canopy Zipline & Hanging Bridges
itinerary.description: Glide across 7 extreme zipline cables skimming the forest canopy. Afternoon walk across 16 hanging bridges spotting sloths and coatis.

itinerary.title: La Fortuna Waterfall & Tabacón Hot Springs
itinerary.description: Hike down 500 steps to the churning pool of La Fortuna Waterfall for a refreshing swim. Unwind in mineral-rich volcanic hot springs.

itinerary.title: Pacuare River Whitewater Rafting Expedition
itinerary.description: Transfer to the Pacuare River. Tackle roaring Class III and IV rapids through sheer rainforest canyons filled with cascading waterfalls.

itinerary.title: Pacuare Jungle Trek & River Relaxation
itinerary.description: Hike to indigenous Cabécar community trails or relax on your riverside deck listening to tropical birds.

itinerary.title: Return to San José & Departure
itinerary.description: Final rapid run down the river, warm lunch, and transfer back to Juan Santamaría Airport.

guestReviews.author: Rachel Green
guestReviews.text: Pacuare rafting was breathtaking and Tabacon hot springs was the most relaxing evening of our lives.

name: Iceland Superjeep Aurora Hunt & Vatnajökull Crystal Ice Caves
title: Iceland Superjeep Aurora Hunt & Vatnajökull Crystal Ice Caves
description: Ride monster-truck Superjeeps across black volcanic deserts, explore natural blue crystal ice caves inside Europe's largest glacier, and chase Northern Lights.
shortDescription: Crystal blue ice caves, Superjeep glacier traverse, and Aurora Borealis.
fullDescription: Venture deep into Iceland’s land of fire and ice. Climb aboard a custom-modified 4x4 Superjeep to conquer snow drifts and river crossings, step into the radiant sapphire depths of natural ice caves beneath Vatnajökull glacier, witness floating icebergs at Jökulsárlón Glacier Lagoon, and hunt the dancing Northern Lights.
highlights: Natural Vatnajökull Crystal Blue Ice Cave guided glacier expedition
Private Superjeep 4x4 glacier driving across volcanic pumice fields
Nightly Aurora Borealis hunting led by professional astrophotographer
Jökulsárlón Glacier Lagoon and Diamond Beach glistening black sands
Soaking in the geothermal waters of the Retreat at Blue Lagoon
included: 5 Nights in luxury Nordic boutique hotels (including ION Adventure Hotel)
Dedicated 4x4 Superjeep and expert Icelandic glacier guide throughout
Glacier crampons, helmets, and ice safety equipment
Private access and spa treatments at the Retreat at Blue Lagoon
Daily Nordic breakfast and 3 chef-curated Icelandic dinners

itinerary.title: Keflavík Arrival & Blue Lagoon Geothermal Soak
itinerary.description: Arrive in Iceland. Luxury transfer to the Retreat at the Blue Lagoon. Soak in mineral-rich geothermal waters surrounded by moss-covered lava fields.

itinerary.title: Golden Circle & Thingvellir Rift Valley
itinerary.description: Drive the Golden Circle: see Gullfoss roaring waterfall, erupting Strokkur geyser, and walk between continental tectonic plates.

itinerary.title: South Coast Waterfalls & Black Sand Beach
itinerary.description: Walk behind Seljalandsfoss waterfall, marvel at Skógafoss, and stand on the black basalt sands of Reynisfjara beneath roaring Atlantic breakers.

itinerary.title: Vatnajökull Crystal Blue Ice Cave & Glacier Lagoon
itinerary.description: Board your Superjeep onto Vatnajökull glacier. Enter the sapphire interior of a natural ice cave. Visit Diamond Beach where icebergs wash ashore.

itinerary.title: Superjeep Highland Traverse & Northern Lights Hunt
itinerary.description: Cross rugged snowdrifts with your guide. Keep vigil away from light pollution to witness the emerald ribbons of the Northern Lights.

itinerary.title: Reykjavik Stroll & Departure
itinerary.description: Explore the colorful streets of downtown Reykjavik and Harpa Concert Hall before airport transfer.

guestReviews.author: Sebastian Meyer
guestReviews.text: Standing inside the blue ice cave was like being inside a giant diamond. Superjeep guide was phenomenal.

name: Patagonia Torres del Paine W-Trek & Grey Glacier Kayaking
title: Patagonia Torres del Paine W-Trek & Grey Glacier Kayaking
description: Trek beneath the granite horns of Los Cuernos, kayak alongside massive icebergs at Grey Glacier, and stay in luxury geodesic eco-domes.
shortDescription: Torres del Paine granite towers, Grey Glacier kayak, and eco-dome luxury.
fullDescription: Challenge yourself in the raw and untamed wilderness at the end of the world. Experience the highlights of the iconic W-Trek in Torres del Paine National Park with seasoned mountain guides. Kayak among floating azure icebergs at Glacier Grey, hike up French Valley, and view sunrise hitting the base of the iconic Torres towers.
highlights: Base of the Towers (Las Torres) iconic sunrise trek
Kayaking in drysuits among floating icebergs at Glacier Grey
French Valley hike with hanging glaciers and rumbling avalanches
Luxury EcoCamp Patagonia geodesic dome stay with wood-burning stoves
Sighting wild guanacos, Andean condors, and Patagonian foxes
included: 6 Nights in premium Suite Domes at EcoCamp Patagonia or Tierra Patagonia
Certified wilderness mountain guides and kayak masters
All park permits, catamaran crossings, and private ground transfers
All meals including hearty trail lunches and fine Chilean wines
excluded: Flights to Punta Arenas (PUQ) or Puerto Natales

itinerary.title: Punta Arenas to Torres del Paine
itinerary.description: Scenic drive across Patagonian pampa watching herds of wild guanacos. Check into your luxury eco-dome facing the granite peaks.

itinerary.title: Trek to the Base of the Towers
itinerary.description: Epic 22km trek through Ascencio Valley up to the glacial moraine lake directly beneath the sheer three granite spires of Las Torres.

itinerary.title: Lake Pehoe Catamaran & French Valley
itinerary.description: Sail across Lake Pehoe's turquoise waters. Hike deep into the French Valley flanked by the massive granite horns of Los Cuernos.

itinerary.title: Glacier Grey Trek & Iceberg Kayaking
itinerary.description: Suit up in specialized drysuits to paddle sea kayaks alongside colossal floating electric-blue icebergs at Grey Glacier.

itinerary.title: Laguna Azul & Wild Pampa Safari
itinerary.description: Explore the gentle trails around Laguna Azul where guanacos graze against the backdrop of the towers. Enjoy a traditional Patagonian lamb asado.

itinerary.title: Nordenskjöld Lake & Waterfall Trail
itinerary.description: Hike along Salto Grande waterfall connecting Lake Nordenskjöld and Lake Pehoe with condors circling overhead.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: Farewell breakfast and private transfer back to Punta Arenas Airport.

guestReviews.author: Carlos Gomez
guestReviews.text: Kayaking by Grey Glacier was surreal. The guides and EcoCamp domes were extraordinary.

name: Grand Canyon VIP Helicopter Descent & Colorado River Whitewater
title: Grand Canyon VIP Helicopter Descent & Colorado River Whitewater

Take a private EC130 helicopter descending below the canyon rim to a secluded landing bluff along the Colorado River. Board motorized rafting pontoons to navigate churning whitewaters, and watch the sun paint red sandstone walls gold.
highlights: Private luxury helicopter descent 4,000 feet down below the canyon rim
Champagne landing on private Hualapai tribal land by the riverbank
Thrilling Colorado River whitewater rafting through Travertine Canyon
Grand Canyon West Skywalk glass bridge cantilever experience
Luxury glamping stay at Under Canvas Grand Canyon with stargazing
included: 3 Nights in luxury safari tents at Under Canvas Grand Canyon
Helicopter roundtrip flight with floor-to-ceiling panoramic glass
Full-day river rafting expedition with native Hualapai river guides

itinerary.title: Arrival & Under Canvas Camp Check-in
itinerary.description: Arrive from Las Vegas or Flagstaff. Check into your luxury safari tent with wood-burning stove and private deck. S'mores and stargazing by the fire pit.

itinerary.title: Helicopter Below-the-Rim & Skywalk
itinerary.description: Helicopter flies deep into the gorge below ancient rock layers. Land for a champagne toast on the canyon floor. Walk the horseshoe-shaped glass Skywalk.

itinerary.title: Colorado River Whitewater Rafting
itinerary.description: Full-day motorized whitewater run navigating rapids between towering canyon walls. Hike up to hidden Travertine Falls for a cool freshwater swim.

itinerary.title: South Rim Scenic Overlooks & Departure
itinerary.description: Sunrise view over Mather Point and Bright Angel trail before private transfer to airport.

guestReviews.author: Bradley Cooper
guestReviews.text: Flying below the rim gave me goosebumps. Best way to see the Grand Canyon.

name: Norwegian Fjords Trolltunga Expedition & Nærøyfjord Sea Kayaking
title: Norwegian Fjords Trolltunga Expedition & Nærøyfjord Sea Kayaking
description: Hike to the daring rock promontory of Trolltunga high above Lake Ringedalsvatnet, sea kayak the UNESCO Nærøyfjord, and stay in fjord-view lodges.

Trek with private mountain guides to the world-famous cliff ledge of Trolltunga (Troll's Tongue) jutting 700 meters above the lake, paddle sea kayaks between sheer mountain walls in UNESCO-protected Nærøyfjord, and ride the steep Flåm Railway.
highlights: Guided trek to the iconic Trolltunga cliff jutting over Lake Ringedalsvatnet
Sea kayaking the narrow waters of UNESCO World Heritage Nærøyfjord
Scenic Flåm Railway journey climbing through waterfalls and ravines
Stay at historic fjord-side boutique hotels in Hardanger
Traditional Norwegian cider tasting in the fruit orchards of Ulvik

Professional mountain guides for Trolltunga and kayak masters for Nærøyfjord
Private Mercedes minivan transfers across western fjord routes

Daily Nordic breakfasts and traditional 3-course dinners

itinerary.title: Bergen to Hardangerfjord
itinerary.description: Arrive in Bergen. Private transfer past roaring Steinsdalsfossen waterfall to your hotel on the shores of Hardangerfjord.

itinerary.title: The Epic Trolltunga Hike
itinerary.description: Early start for the challenging 27km hike up to Trolltunga. Stand upon the dramatic stone ledge with vertigo-inducing panoramic lake views.

itinerary.title: Cider Orchards & Hardanger Relaxation
itinerary.description: Rest and recover with a peaceful stroll through blossoming apple orchards in Ulvik. Sample artisanal sparkling hard ciders.

itinerary.title: Nærøyfjord Sea Kayaking Expedition
itinerary.description: Glide across still fjord waters flanked by 1,000-meter cliffs and tumbling waterfalls in the narrowest fjord in Europe.

itinerary.title: Flåm Railway & Stegastein Viewpoint
itinerary.description: Ride the Flåm Railway up to Myrdal. Walk out onto the wooden Stegastein cantilever viewpoint hanging 650m over Aurlandsfjord.

itinerary.title: Bergen Bryggen Stroll & Departure
itinerary.description: Return to Bergen. Explore UNESCO Bryggen wooden wharf before flight departure.

guestReviews.author: Astrid Lindholm
guestReviews.text: Standing on Trolltunga was exhilarating. Norway's nature is simply awe-inspiring.

name: Dolomites Cortina Via Ferrata & Alta Via Alpine Hut Traverse
title: Dolomites Cortina Via Ferrata & Alta Via Alpine Hut Traverse
description: Climb protected iron-path Via Ferrata routes across jagged pale limestone spires, stay in scenic mountain rifugios, and gaze over Tre Cime di Lavaredo.

Clip your carabiners onto World War I historic Via Ferrata cables with UIAGM alpine guides, trek across the Alta Via 1 alpine trails, admire the sheer three towers of Tre Cime di Lavaredo at sunset, and savor Michelin-caliber Ladin dining in Cortina.
highlights: Climbing exhilarating Via Ferrata routes with certified UIAGM alpine guides
Sunrise circuit trek around Tre Cime di Lavaredo three iconic monoliths
Overnight stay in a high-elevation alpine rifugio with panoramic terrace
Lake Braies (Pragser Wildsee) emerald rowboat morning experience
5-Star Alpine spa resort stay in Cortina d'Ampezzo

UIAGM alpine guide and all Via Ferrata equipment (harness, helmet, lanyard set)
All cable cars and mountain toll passes
Daily Italian breakfasts and 2 alpine dinners with South Tyrolean wines

itinerary.title: Venice to Cortina d'Ampezzo
itinerary.description: Private luxury transfer from Venice Marco Polo up into the heart of the Dolomites. Stroll Cortina's glamorous Corso Italia.

itinerary.title: Tre Cime di Lavaredo & Via Ferrata Innerkofler
itinerary.description: Trek the circuit of the three towers. Clip into iron cables through WWI rock tunnels leading to the summit of Monte Paterno.

itinerary.title: Cinque Torri Rock Climbing & High Rifugio
itinerary.description: Explore the surreal towers of Cinque Torri. Ascend to Rifugio Nuvolau perched on an eagle's aerie ridge for sunset and night under the stars.

itinerary.title: Lake Braies Rowboat & Cortina Spa
itinerary.description: Descend to Lake Braies. Row wooden boats across crystalline turquoise water surrounded by sheer mountain reflections. Unwind in the hotel spa.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: Breakfast with views of Monte Cristallo before transfer back to Venice.

guestReviews.author: Matteo Rossi
guestReviews.text: The Via Ferrata climbing was exciting yet felt completely safe with the guide. Unbelievable mountain vistas.

name: Peru Classic Inca Trail VIP Expedition & Machu Picchu Sunrise
title: Peru Classic Inca Trail VIP Expedition & Machu Picchu Sunrise

Return journey on the ultra-luxury Hiram Bingham vintage Pullman train

itinerary.title: Arrive in Cusco & Acclimatization
itinerary.description: Arrive in Cusco (3,400m). Transfer to Palacio Nazarenas. Gentle walking tour through San Blas artisan quarter and ancient Inca stone walls.

itinerary.title: Sacred Valley of the Incas
itinerary.description: Visit Pisac ruins and Ollantaytambo living Inca town. Acclimate comfortably in the lower elevation of the Sacred Valley.

itinerary.title: Inca Trail Day 1: Km 82 to Wayllabamba
itinerary.description: Pass checkpoint at Km 82. Trek alongside the Urubamba River with views of snowcapped Veronica Peak to your first luxury camp.

itinerary.title: Inca Trail Day 2: Dead Woman's Pass to Pacaymayo
itinerary.description: Ascend ancient stone stairways through cloud forests to the summit of Warmiwañusqa (4,215m). Descend to camp for hot tea and massage.

itinerary.title: Inca Trail Day 3: Runkurakay & Wiñay Wayna
itinerary.description: Explore magnificent ruins of Sayacmarca and Phuyupatamarca ('Town in the Clouds') surrounded by orchids.

itinerary.title: Inca Trail Day 4: Sun Gate to Machu Picchu
itinerary.description: Hike to the Sun Gate for the unforgettable first glimpse of Machu Picchu glowing in morning mist. Comprehensive private tour of the citadel.

itinerary.title: Hiram Bingham Train Return to Cusco
itinerary.description: Indulge on the Belmond Hiram Bingham train with live Peruvian music and gourmet dining on the scenic journey back to Cusco.

guestReviews.author: Gabriel Santos
guestReviews.text: Entering Machu Picchu from the Sun Gate brought tears to my eyes. The VIP camping team was world-class.

name: South Africa Great White Shark Cage Diving & Table Mountain Abseil
title: South Africa Great White Shark Cage Diving & Table Mountain Abseil

Helicopter flight along the Twelve Apostles and Camps Bay coast

Boulders Beach African penguin colony walking excursion

itinerary.title: Arrive in Cape Town & V&A Waterfront

itinerary.title: Table Mountain Abseil & 12 Apostles Helicopter
itinerary.description: Ascend Table Mountain via cable car. Abseil 112 meters down the vertical face with the Atlantic ocean far below. Helicopter flip along the coast.

itinerary.title: Gansbaai Great White Shark Cage Diving
itinerary.description: Early morning transfer to Gansbaai. Board the research catamaran out to Shark Alley. Lower into the cage to come face-to-face with apex predators.

itinerary.title: Cape Point & Boulders Beach Penguins
itinerary.description: Drive Chapman’s Peak cliff road. Walk alongside African penguins on Boulders Beach and reach the southwestern tip of the continent at Cape Point.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: Morning coffee in colorful Bo-Kaap before private airport transfer.

guestReviews.author: Liam O'Connor
guestReviews.text: Stepping off the top of Table Mountain and looking down at Camps Bay was pure adrenaline!

name: Kyoto Imperial Shinto Sanctuaries & Authentic Tea Master Ceremony
title: Kyoto Imperial Shinto Sanctuaries & Authentic Tea Master Ceremony

Day excursion to Nara Todai-ji Great Buddha and sacred bowing deer

itinerary.title: Fushimi Inari & Golden Pavilion (Kinkaku-ji)
itinerary.description: Hike the forested paths of Fushimi Inari through 10,000 red gates. Continue to the shimmering gold-leaf reflection of Kinkaku-ji and Ryoan-ji rock garden.

itinerary.title: Arashiyama Bamboo Grove & Master Tea Ceremony
itinerary.description: Wander the towering green stalks of Sagano Bamboo Forest. Partake in a contemplative tea ceremony with a 15th-generation Urasenke master.

itinerary.title: Nara Great Buddha & Sacred Deer
itinerary.description: Visit Todai-ji to stand before the world's largest bronze Buddha statue. Feed rice crackers to free-roaming sacred sika deer in Nara Park.

itinerary.title: Historic Ryokan Stay & Geiko Evening
itinerary.description: Check into a centuries-old ryokan. Bathe in private cedar onsen baths. Enjoy a private Kaiseki banquet featuring dance by an authentic Maiko.

itinerary.title: Kiyomizu-dera & Departure
itinerary.description: Walk the wooden cantilevered stage of Kiyomizu-dera overlooking cherry or maple foliage before transfer.

guestReviews.author: Kenji Takahashi
guestReviews.text: The private tea ceremony and kaiseki dinner in Gion were deeply moving. Exceptional authenticity.

itinerary.title: Colosseum Underground Hypogeum & Roman Forum

itinerary.title: Borghese Gallery & Trastevere Wine Cellar

itinerary.title: After-Hours Vatican Museums & Sistine Chapel

itinerary.title: Pantheon Stroll & Departure
itinerary.description: Morning visit to the magnificent dome of the Pantheon before airport transfer.

guestReviews.author: Eleanor Roosevelt-Smith
guestReviews.text: Having the Sistine Chapel virtually to ourselves with only ten people was the most moving cultural experience of my life.

itinerary.title: Giza Pyramids, Sphinx Paws & Saqqara

itinerary.title: Grand Egyptian Museum & Flight to Luxor
itinerary.description: Marvel at the complete Tutankhamun golden treasure collection in the new Grand Egyptian Museum. Evening flight to Luxor.

itinerary.title: Luxor Balloon Flight & Valley of the Kings

itinerary.description: Walk through the awe-inspiring Great Hypostyle Hall of Karnak with 134 colossal columns. Raise the sails of your Dahabiya to cruise south.

itinerary.title: Edfu & Kom Ombo Temples

guestReviews.author: William Sterling

itinerary.title: Arrive in Anchorage & Coastal Trail
itinerary.description: Arrive at Ted Stevens Anchorage Airport. Check into your boutique hotel. Walk the Tony Knowles Coastal Trail watching for urban moose.

itinerary.title: Scenic Seward Highway to Kenai Peninsula
itinerary.description: Drive along Turnagain Arm watching for beluga whales. Check in at your luxury seaside lodge in Seward.

itinerary.title: Kenai Fjords Glacier & Whale Cruise
itinerary.description: Navigate deep into Kenai Fjords. Watch massive ice chunks crash into the sea from Aialik Glacier. Encounter orcas, humpback whales, sea otters, and puffins.

itinerary.title: GoldStar Dome Train to Denali
itinerary.description: Board the luxury glass-domed train. Glide past roaring rivers, alpine peaks, and Hurricane Gulch bridge to Denali National Park.

itinerary.title: Denali Tundra Wilderness Safari
itinerary.description: Deep journey along Denali Park Road. Scan alpine meadows for grizzly bears digging for roots, Dall sheep high on cliffs, and moose.

itinerary.title: Denali Sled Dog Kennels & Flightseeing
itinerary.description: Visit the historic park sled dog demonstration. Optional ski-plane glacier landing on the flanks of Denali.

itinerary.title: Return to Anchorage & Departure
itinerary.description: Scenic transfer back to Anchorage for departure flight.

guestReviews.author: Travis Vance
guestReviews.text: A mother grizzly and two cubs walked right past our bus in Denali. Alaska is majestic beyond words.

name: Arctic Svalbard Polar Bear Zodiac Expedition & Walrus Colonies
title: Arctic Svalbard Polar Bear Zodiac Expedition & Walrus Colonies
description: Sail into the pack ice of the High Arctic aboard a polar-class expedition ship, track kings of the Arctic (polar bears), and see walrus haul-outs.
shortDescription: High Arctic pack ice, wild polar bear tracking, and walrus colonies.
fullDescription: Venture to the realm of the midnight sun and the ice kingdom. Just 600 miles from the North Pole, navigate the dramatic fjords and frozen pack ice of Svalbard. From ice-strengthened expedition vessels and sturdy Zodiac crafts, encounter majestic polar bears hunting seals on sea ice, massive walrus colonies, and Arctic foxes.
highlights: Encountering wild polar bears on sea pack ice in their natural habitat
Zodiac safaris to walrus haul-outs and 14th of July Glacier ice cliffs
Sailing above 80° North latitude under 24 hours of Midnight Sun
Witnessing tens of thousands of Brünnich's guillemots and Arctic terns
Luxury ice-strengthened expedition vessel with sauna, lectures, and chef dining
included: 7 Nights aboard luxury polar expedition ship in outside balcony suite
All Zodiac cruises, shore landings, and polar bear safety rifle escorts
Complimentary high-grade insulated polar expedition parka to keep
All meals, snacks, open bar, and informative lectures by polar scientists
excluded: Travel insurance with polar evacuation coverage

itinerary.title: Longyearbyen Embarkation
itinerary.description: Arrive in Longyearbyen, the northernmost town on Earth. Board your expedition vessel and sail out into Isfjorden under the midnight sun.

itinerary.title: Kongsfjorden & Ny-Ålesund Research Base
itinerary.description: Cruise through majestic Kongsfjorden with soaring glacier fronts. Visit the historic scientific research outpost of Ny-Ålesund.

itinerary.title: Northwest Spitsbergen & Walrus Haul-outs
itinerary.description: Zodiac landing at Moffen Island or Poolepynten to observe massive tusked walruses resting together on gravel banks.

itinerary.title: Cruising the Edge of the Polar Pack Ice
itinerary.description: Navigate ice-strengthened hull through sea ice sheets. Lookouts on the bridge scan for polar bears stalking ringed seals.

itinerary.title: Hinlopen Strait & Alkefjellet Bird Cliffs
itinerary.description: Marvel at Alkefjellet’s sheer basalt towers where 60,000 pairs of guillemots nest. Zodiac cruise among floating turquoise icebergs.

itinerary.title: Monacobreen Glacier & Iceberg Kayaking
itinerary.description: Sail up to the colossal 5-kilometer face of Monacobreen glacier. Listen to thunderous cracks of ice calving into the sea.

itinerary.title: Bellsund Fjord & Reindeer Tundra
itinerary.description: Walk on flowering Arctic tundra. Spot endemic Svalbard reindeer grazing and Arctic foxes hunting in their summer coats.

itinerary.title: Longyearbyen Disembarkation
itinerary.description: Disembark after breakfast. Time for tax-free shopping in Longyearbyen before flight to Oslo.

guestReviews.author: Capt. Erik Thorne
guestReviews.text: Watching a polar bear mother guide her two cubs across pack ice 600 miles from the North Pole was deeply moving.

name: Costa Rica Tortuguero Sea Turtle Nesting & Sloth Sanctuary
title: Costa Rica Tortuguero Sea Turtle Nesting & Sloth Sanctuary
description: Witness endangered green sea turtles laying eggs on Caribbean beaches under starry skies, explore jungle waterways, and spot two-toed sloths.
shortDescription: Green sea turtle nocturnal nesting, Amazon-like jungle canals, and sloths.
fullDescription: Known as the Amazon of Central America, Tortuguero is a remote network of lush jungle canals accessible only by boat or small plane. Experience the awe-inspiring night-time nesting ritual of colossal green sea turtles on protected Caribbean sands, boat through mist-filled waterways spotting sloths, monkeys, and caimans.
highlights: Nocturnal guided green sea turtle nesting expedition with conservation biologists
Quiet electric-boat safaris through narrow primary rainforest canals
Spotting three-toed and two-toed sloths, river otters, and spectacled caimans
Stay in eco-lodge nestled between Tortuguero lagoon and the Caribbean Sea
Private charter flight providing aerial views of Costa Rica's lush canopy
included: 4 Nights in luxury eco-lodge in Tortuguero and San José
Official nocturnal turtle nesting permits and red-light certified naturalist guides
Scenic domestic charter flights (San José - Tortuguero - San José)
All meals featuring fresh tropical Caribbean gastronomy
excluded: Gratuities for guides and boat captain

itinerary.title: San José to Tortuguero Scenic Flight
itinerary.description: Scenic flight over cloudforests landing on the coastal strip of Tortuguero. Boat transfer to your secluded riverside lodge.

itinerary.title: Jungle Canal Safari & Sloth Tracking
itinerary.description: Early morning boat safari through peaceful canals as howler monkeys roar. Spot sloths hanging in cecropia trees and toucans overhead.

itinerary.title: Nocturnal Sea Turtle Nesting Patrol
itinerary.description: Relax by the lodge pool during the day. In the dark of night, accompany certified biologists to observe a massive green sea turtle excavate her nest.

itinerary.title: Tortuguero Village & Kayak Expedition
itinerary.description: Visit the colorful Caribbean village of Tortuguero. Paddle peaceful kayaks through hidden creeks lined with lush orchids.

itinerary.title: Flight Back to San José & Departure
itinerary.description: Breakfast with tropical bird song before scenic return flight to San José for international connection.

guestReviews.author: Melanie Foster
guestReviews.text: Watching a sea turtle lay her eggs under the stars was an unforgettable, spiritual moment.

name: Madagascar Andasibe Indri Lemurs & Avenue of Baobabs
title: Madagascar Andasibe Indri Lemurs & Avenue of Baobabs
description: Hear the haunting wail of the Indri lemur in misty Andasibe rainforests, photograph ancient giant Baobab trees at sunset, and see chameleons.
shortDescription: Giant Indri lemurs, iconic Avenue of the Baobabs sunset, and chameleons.
fullDescription: Venture to the eighth continent, where over 90% of wildlife exists nowhere else on Earth. Walk through the misty montane rainforest of Andasibe to encounter the Indri—the largest living lemur whose haunting calls echo for miles. Fly to Morondava to stand beneath the prehistoric sentinel trees of the world-famous Avenue of the Baobabs at sunset.
bestTime: September to December, April to June
highlights: Tracking the critically endangered Indri lemur and diademed sifakas in Andasibe
Sunset and golden hour photography at the iconic Avenue of the Baobabs
Night forest walks spotting mouse lemurs, leaf-tailed geckos, and chameleons
Stay in eco-luxury forest lodges surrounded by primary rainforest
Private domestic flights connecting Antananarivo and Morondava
included: 6 Nights in luxury eco-lodges and boutique hotels (Vakôna Forest Lodge / Palissandre)
Domestic flights within Madagascar (Antananarivo - Morondava - Antananarivo)
Dedicated 4x4 vehicle with professional driver-guide and national park trackers
All park admission permits, night walks, and daily breakfast

itinerary.title: Arrive in Antananarivo (Tana)
itinerary.description: Arrive at Ivato International Airport. Transfer to boutique hotel in historic Upper Town overlooking the capital city.

itinerary.title: Scenic Drive to Andasibe Rainforest
itinerary.description: Drive east past rice paddies and fruit stalls into the lush rainforest belt. Check in at Vakôna Forest Lodge. Nocturnal walk for chameleons.

itinerary.title: Analamazaotra Reserve Indri Trek
itinerary.description: Follow the haunting song of the Indri lemur through the canopy. Spot golden diademed sifakas leaping gracefully between branches.

itinerary.title: Lemur Island & Flight to Morondava
itinerary.description: Visit Lemur Island where friendly brown lemurs jump onto shoulders. Return to Tana for flight to Morondava on the Mozambique Channel coast.

itinerary.title: The Majestic Avenue of the Baobabs
itinerary.description: Drive to the Avenue of the Baobabs. Admire these 800-year-old colossal trees towering 30 meters high. Watch the sky ignite in orange and purple at sunset.

itinerary.title: Kirindy Forest Fosa Predator Safari
itinerary.description: Explore the dry deciduous Kirindy Forest tracking Madagascar's top predator, the fosa, and giant jumping rats.

itinerary.title: Return to Tana & Departure
itinerary.description: Flight back to Antananarivo for craft market shopping before evening international departure.

guestReviews.author: Claire Fontaine
guestReviews.text: Hearing the Indri sing right above our heads sent chills down my spine. The Baobabs at sunset look like another planet.

name: Australia Great Barrier Reef Coral Spawning & Kangaroo Island Safari
title: Australia Great Barrier Reef Coral Spawning & Kangaroo Island Safari
description: Dive the outer Great Barrier Reef on a private catamaran charter, walk among wild koalas, sea lions, and kangaroos on pristine Kangaroo Island.
shortDescription: Outer Great Barrier Reef private catamaran, wild koalas, and sea lions.
fullDescription: Experience Australia's most spectacular wildlife wonders. Board a luxury private catamaran from Port Douglas to the remote outer ribbon reefs of the Great Barrier Reef to snorkel vibrant coral gardens. Fly south to Kangaroo Island—Australia's Galapagos—to walk among wild Australian sea lions and observe wild koalas and echidnas.
highlights: Private catamaran expedition to pristine Outer Ribbon Reefs with marine biologist
Walking on Seal Bay beach among endangered wild Australian sea lions
Spotting wild koalas resting in eucalyptus trees and kangaroos at sunset
Stay in Southern Ocean Lodge luxury cliffside suite overlooking the roaring Southern Ocean
Scenic flights over Remarkable Rocks and Admirals Arch stalactites
included: 6 Nights in luxury 5-star lodges (Silky Oaks Lodge / Southern Ocean Lodge)
Private Outer Reef sailing charter with marine biologist and chef lunch
Kangaroo Island 4WD wildlife safari with professional ecologist
All meals, premium Australian wines, and domestic connecting flights

itinerary.title: Cairns to Daintree Rainforest
itinerary.description: Arrive in Cairns. Scenic coastal drive north to Silky Oaks Lodge nestled in the ancient Daintree Rainforest.

itinerary.title: Outer Great Barrier Reef Private Sail
itinerary.description: Board luxury catamaran to Agincourt Ribbon Reefs. Snorkel crystal-clear coral walls with sea turtles, clownfish, and giant clams.

itinerary.title: Daintree River Crocodiles to Adelaide
itinerary.description: Spot saltwater crocodiles on a river cruise. Evening flight south to Adelaide and connecting transfer to Kangaroo Island.

itinerary.title: Seal Bay Wild Sea Lions & Koalas
itinerary.description: Walk on the white sands of Seal Bay alongside wild sea lions basking in the sun. Search Hanson Bay eucalyptus groves for sleeping wild koalas.

itinerary.title: Flinders Chase National Park & Remarkable Rocks
itinerary.description: Explore the giant sculpted granite boulders of Remarkable Rocks and Admirals Arch where New Zealand fur seals surf the waves.

itinerary.title: Kangaroo Island Wilderness & Wine Tasting
itinerary.description: Watch mobs of kangaroos grazing at twilight in open pastures. Savor boutique Kangaroo Island honey, gin, and South Australian Shiraz.

itinerary.title: Adelaide Departure
itinerary.description: Morning scenic flight back to Adelaide for onward travel.

guestReviews.author: Grace Holloway
guestReviews.text: The Great Barrier Reef reef charter was out of this world, and seeing wild koalas and kangaroos on Kangaroo Island made our dream come true.

name: Brazil Pantanal Wild Jaguar Tracking & Giant River Otter Safari
title: Brazil Pantanal Wild Jaguar Tracking & Giant River Otter Safari
description: Cruise the Cuiabá River on private motorboats to track wild jaguars hunting caimans, see giant river otters, and spot hyacinth macaws.
shortDescription: Wild jaguar riverboat tracking, giant river otters, and hyacinth macaws.
fullDescription: Venture deep into the Pantanal—the world's largest tropical wetland with the highest concentration of wildlife in the Americas. Based in specialized river lodges along the Cuiabá River, take nimble aluminum speedboats into narrow tributaries where wild jaguars patrol riverbanks hunting capybaras and caimans with unmatched regularity.
highlights: High-probability wild jaguar tracking boat safaris along the Cuiabá River
Observing giant river otter family groups feeding and playing in the shallows
Photographing vibrant cobalt-blue Hyacinth Macaws nesting in palm trees
Night spotlighting safaris spotting ocelots, tapirs, and hundreds of caimans
Stay in floating or riverside safari lodges in the heart of Jaguarland
included: 5 Nights in luxury Pantanal safari lodges and floating hotel houseboats
Private specialized boat with driver and bilingual wildlife biologist tracker
All transfers from Cuiabá (CGB) via the Transpantaneira Highway in 4x4
All meals, snacks, water, and park conservation entry fees
excluded: Tips for boat captain and tracker

itinerary.title: Cuiabá to Transpantaneira Highway
itinerary.description: Arrive at Cuiabá Airport. 4x4 drive along the dirt Transpantaneira Highway crossing wooden bridges teeming with thousands of caimans and jabiru storks.

itinerary.title: Journey to Porto Jofre Jaguar Zone
itinerary.description: Travel deep into the Meeting of the Waters State Park. Board your riverboat lodge. Afternoon cruise spotting capybaras and kingfishers.

itinerary.title: Cuiabá River Wild Jaguar Tracking
itinerary.description: Full-day boat safari scanning sandbanks and river bends. Watch powerful wild jaguars stalking caimans on riverbanks.

itinerary.title: Giant River Otters & Piquiri River
itinerary.description: Follow loud vocalizations to family groups of giant river otters. Second full day of jaguar tracking in narrow lagoons.

itinerary.title: Hyacinth Macaws & Night Spotlight Safari
itinerary.description: Photograph the world’s largest flying parrots (Hyacinth Macaws). Evening night spotlighting safari for tapirs, anteaters, and nightjars.

itinerary.title: Return to Cuiabá & Departure
itinerary.description: Morning boat trip before transfer back along the Transpantaneira to Cuiabá for departure flights.

guestReviews.author: Dr. Rodrigo Silva
guestReviews.text: We saw six different jaguars in three days, including a male taking down a caiman on the riverbank! Unsurpassed wildlife spectacle.
